Urinary Retention

Ailment bladder urinary fluid-balance urgency incomplete-voiding

Evidence: scientific

Summary

Difficulty emptying the bladder completely, leading to urinary urgency and potential bladder dysfunction.

Symptoms

  • urinary urgency
  • difficulty starting urination
  • weak urine stream
  • incomplete bladder emptying
  • frequent nighttime urination

Other Treatment Options

  • Bladder Issues
    Bladder dysfunction including urinary retention, urgency, and discomfort, often linked to fluid imbalance and tissue salt deficiencies.
  • Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
    Infection anywhere in the urinary tract, most commonly in women. Characterized by burning pain during urination and frequent urges.
  • Kidney & Bladder Health
    Comprehensive kidney and bladder health covering urinary tract infections, bladder dysfunction, kidney stones, and related conditions affecting fluid balance and toxin removal.
  • Diuretic Herbs & Bladder Tonics
    Collection of herbal formulas specifically designed to support bladder function and promote healthy urinary elimination.
  • Adrenal Fatigue
    Hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal axis dysfunction leading to chronic fatigue and stress intolerance.
  • Prostatitis
    Inflammation of the prostate gland, often causing pain and urinary symptoms.
  • Enlarged Prostate (Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia / BPH)
    Enlarged prostate (benign prostatic hyperplasia) is a non-cancerous enlargement of the prostate gland common in older men. Symptoms include difficulty starting urination, weak urine stream, frequent urination, nocturia (waking at night to urinate), and incomplete bladder emptying. It can progress to urinary retention requiring medical intervention.
  • Ashwagandha Root Extract
    Adaptogenic herb that helps the body manage stress, supports thyroid function, and reduces cortisol levels.
  • Saw Palmetto (Serenoa repens)
    Saw palmetto berries are the most researched herbal remedy for benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH). Standardized extracts containing 85-95% fatty acids and sterols have shown efficacy in reducing urinary symptoms associated with enlarged prostate.
  • Pygeum Africanum (Prunus africana)
    Pygeum bark extract from the African cherry tree is a well-studied remedy for BPH and prostatitis. It contains phytosterols (including beta-sitosterol) and triterpenes that reduce prostate inflammation and improve urinary flow.
  • Nettle Root (Urtica dioica radix)
    Nettle root (distinct from nettle leaf) is specific for prostate health. It contains lectins and sterols that bind to sex hormone binding globulin (SHBG) and may inhibit 5-alpha reductase, reducing DHT conversion. Often combined with saw palmetto for BPH.
  • Pumpkin Seed (Cucurbita pepo)
    Pumpkin seeds are rich in zinc, phytosterols (beta-sitosterol), and antioxidants that support prostate health. They inhibit 5-alpha reductase activity and reduce DHT binding to prostate receptors. Traditional food-medicine for prostate and urinary health.
  • Buchu (Barosma betulina)
    Buchu is a traditional Southern African remedy for urinary tract infections and bladder inflammation. The leaves contain diosphenol and other compounds with antibacterial properties against common UTI pathogens. It has a long history for painful urination and prostate support.

Treatment Approaches

  • Proven Catheterization (intermittent or indwelling) for acute retention; alpha-blockers for chronic retention due to BPH
  • Historical Traditional use of corn silk, uva ursi, and horsetail as gentle diuretics and urinary tonics
  • Experimental Acupuncture and neuromodulation (sacral nerve stimulation) for neurogenic urinary retention
  • Conventional Treat underlying cause (BPH medication, stricture dilation, pelvic floor PT); scheduled voiding and double voiding techniques
